text: Mohtaram afsaran, Shah Faisal Colony No 3 (District Korangi) mein aik sath teen mukhtalif idaron ke masail hain. Awwal ye ke main road par shadeed khaday par chuke hain jis se aam raft-o-aamad mein shadeed rukawat pesh aa rahi hai, doyam ye ke sewerage line ubal rahi hai aur ganda badboodar pani poori gali mein jam chuka hai, aur soyam mazeed ye ke feeder trip ho jane ke sabab bar bar unannounced loadshedding ki ja rahi hai. In teeno alag alag masail ka fori jaeza le kar karrawai farmai jaye.
